from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LongTermEquityInvestmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """A reported long-term equity investment value from one quarterly report."""
    report_year: str | None = Field(description="The calendar year of the report (e.g., '2021', '2022')")
    period_description: str | None = Field(description="How the period is described (e.g., '2020年末', '2021年3月31日')")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is beginning or ending balance ('期初余额', '期末余额')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The long-term equity investment amount in CNY yuan")
    report_title: str | None = Field(description="Which report contains this data")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the report containing this figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    long_term_equity_investment_records: list[LongTermEquityInvestmentRecord]
